notes.note: #0.90-0.100 are 11 leader variants. 0357.bla's non-Zero Pt_Chara_Check run (ids 14,11,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,9,10) gives Mebius, Ultraman, Rider 1, RX, Den-O (Momotaros), W, OOO, Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00, so this slice starts at RX (#0.93). Same order for #0.102-0.112 and #0.118-0.128. Voices match (polite OOO #0.96/#0.124, Zeta #0.98/#0.126; rough Momotaros #0.94/#0.106/#0.122).
Zeta's variant is the polite form of #0.93/#0.97; politeness carried by 'the two of you' only.
Mebius, W, OOO, Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero and 00 share the identical line, so all get 'That's a relief...'. #0.103 is Ultraman (dignified), #0.104 Rider 1, #0.105 RX, #0.106 Momotaros.
Seven's sentence deliberately trails off; Jack cuts in at #0.114.
Mebius (polite, addressing his elder brothers Seven and Jack). 'Base' = the heroes' own base, so 'our base'. #0.119 differs from #0.123 only by a particle; same English.
Narration uses Ultraseven's full name and plain 'Jack'; kept as in source.

0358 shout/narration pairs follow Pt_Chara_Check ids 15,14,11,12,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,9,10: Zero, Mebius, Ultraman, Seven, Rider 1, RX, Den-O, W, OOO, Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00 (confirmed by each narration row naming that leader). 'Ultraman... Zoffy' (#0.26/#0.28) is Wing Zero / 00 identifying an unfamiliar hero; #0.16 is Momotaros.
Mebius, Ultraman and Seven call Zoffy 'nii-san': 'Brother Zoffy', matching earlier 'Brother Hikari'.
Zoffy's 'watashi to shita koto ga' (how unlike me) trails off; rendered as an unfinished 'To think that I, of all people...'.
Source literally says the enemy calls 'this world' Regis, though elsewhere Regis is the alliance's name. Kept literal.
'Sono kenkyuu bumon' = the research division of that organization (Regis); 'their' keeps it attached to the enemy.

#0.42-0.54 one line per leader in the 0358 order above (#0.42 Zero ... #0.50 OOO; #0.51-0.54 Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00 in story_064). Identical source lines share 'Where are they?'; polite form (#0.43 Mebius, #0.50 OOO) 'Where can we find them?'; #0.48 Momotaros rough; #0.49 W uses a softer pronoun for 'them'.

report: All 80 rows translated. Leader-variant order taken from 0357.bla / 0358.bla Pt_Chara_Check runs and confirmed by narration names and voices. Uncertain: 0358 #0.40 says the enemy calls 'this world' Regis (kept literal). No new names.
